name: Logitech G29
author: TAA36598SansD
source: Sketchfab model, the wheel only, converted and fitted for the app
notes: The wheel only: the base, the pedal set and a stray part are left out (the app turns the whole model). SketchUp's back-face copies removed, one-sided faces turned outwards, the rim's 24° tilt taken out so it faces +Z, scaled to 0.27 m across and centred on the hub. Colours set to the real wheel's finish (black leather rim, brushed metal spokes); the source has no textures.
